Gem Staves & Gem Robes
Gem staves completely reworked!
Each gem enchants gem staff shots with a unique effect
Equipping a gem robe also enchants gem staff shots with the robe's gem effect.
Matching a gem staff and robe increases the gem staff's shot damage.
Reduced the metal cost of gem staffs by ~30%.
Added Kinship Peach.
Added Little Kinship Peach.
All pals can be empowered using kinship peaches!
Added Giant Tiki.
Added Guide To Old Style Parkour, which restores some player movement techniques removed in 1.4.5.
Glowsticks, Flares and Bombs can now be picked-up from the world by right-clicking them.
Sentries can now be dismissed by right-clicking them.
Freeze Bombs can now be placed on weapon racks.
Music Box (Torch God) can now be crafted after defeating the Torch God.
Digtoise now disappears upon entering Shimmer.
Defender Medal stacks in the world now merge.
Dangersense now highlights Hellstone even if you have fire block immunity (on account of creating lava when mined).
Yoraiz0r's Spell can now be equipped in a vanity slot even if another wing is in a vanity slot.
Stylist now sells Pretty Mirrors when in the graveyard, instead of the Clothier.

Martian Saucer now stops firing at the player if they are slain and there are no other targets, or if the Saucer begins to flee. It now stops firing its Deathray when the Saucer transitions from Phase One to Phase Two.
Ghosts from Tombstones and Wraiths from Demon/Crimson Altars now respect the Journey Mode spawnrate slider.
Leashed turtles, frogs and water striders no longer have bubbles when underwater.
Improved leashed Water Strider and Grasshopper behaviour with water.
Leashed fish no longer voluntarily leave water, and other leashed fliers no longer enter it.
Leashed fish now bob less, making them less likely to clip out of the waterline.
Leashed critters no longer move through slopes.
Leashed critters have more form-fitting bubbles.
You can no longer earn a banner if you already have a full unclaimed stack of that banner's type. You monster.
You can once again stand on the bottom of the world in non-Skyblock worlds.
The Distressed Pal event now guarantees the pal you've yet to obtain.
The Distressed Pal event is now 25% more common.
Homeless NPCs can no longer spawn when time is frozen (same as regular NPC spawning).
Jungle Spores are now considered the 'mushroom' of Jungle Grass and will convert as such.

sections.t: Fixed the Aether biome sometimes generating without Shimmer.
lines: Ice Chests now treat the Fish as a secondary item, allowing other loot to spawn alongside it.
Jungle Chests now treat Seaweed as a secondary item, allowing other loot to spawn alongside it.
Hell Forts now have a chance to have crumbled walls if said walls are not between rooms, and exposed to the air.
Minecart Tracks now avoid Explosives, Detonators, Dressers and Chests when generating.
Added a new background cloud.
Added two new secret seeds. Shocking, isn't it?
Pressure plates, spikes and geysers are now removed if the spawn point is placed on them.
Devourers and World Feeders can now spawn on "royale with cheese" + "purify this" worlds once the Eater of Worlds has been defeated.
Many improvements to "dual daring dangers" worlds.
Improved how "dual daring dangers" and "water park" interact.
Improved how "dual daring dangers" and "Not The Bees!" interact.
"sandy britches" no longer generates massive walls of dirt under some structures on "skyblock" and "planetoid" worlds.
Increased the minimum amount of rain on "bring a towel" worlds.
Added loadout equipment sharing! Favorite any equipment to make it shareable between loadouts!
Dead players can now skip the respawn timer when there's no great danger around them.
Basilisk mount can now fit through 3 block tall corridors.
Digtoise now appears on the minimap, and its item icon indicates whether it is summoned.
Quest Fish can now be picked up even if you already have one of the same type.
Stress ball now works when game screen focus is lost.
Torch god's flames no longer hurt players other than the one who is going through its trial.
Distressed Cattiva & Distressed Foxparks now take 5 damage from all hits, and should have a fair chance to be saved in higher difficulties.
You can now open locked chests by directly using the key on them with your cursor (old method still works as well).
Updated Banner of the Beast.
Updated Chlorophyte Dye's glowmask.
Walls with tiles in front of them once again draw over other walls (as before 1.4.5).
The defense counter now has a unique outline color on Legendary difficulty.
Fixed a gray pixel in the Marathon Medalist icon.
The Moon Lord's shader now better preserves bright reds and greens.
Made some slight improvements to some of the Snow biome backgrounds.
Items picked up from the ground are now always highlighted if the Highlight New Items feature is enabled, regardless of how they're obtained.

You can now adjust how the Sniper Rifle/Scope's zoom function works using the "Forward Zoom" option in the Keybinding menu. The available settings are Hold To Use, Click To Toggle, Always On, and Always Off.
On gamepad, switching to the equipment menu while holding an item will now move the cursor directly to a valid equipment slot. This also works for Mannequins and Hat Racks.
In the Banner Menu, newly obtained banners are now highlighted.
Increased the scroll speed of the credits.
Improved gamepad navigation of the crafting UI.
The "Clear" button for the search bar is now accessible with gamepad in the Bestiary, Journey Duplication and Crafting UIs.
Items that are intended for a specific player are now briefly reserved for that player. This applies to (among others) mining, catching critters and using the Extractinator.
The team selection controls now give better gamepad feedback when on cooldown.
Empty servers now only start updating when a client fully connects.
Servers now log a message when a player disconnects before having joined the world.
Fixed Steam hosts not sending the kick reason when the person trying to join isn't the host's friend.
Fixed hotkey dashes not being synced.
Player direction changes are now properly synced.
Fixed a malicious packet exploit.
Servers no longer reserve slots for clients that connect and immediately disconnect.
Servers no longer attempt to send data to clients slots when their clients have disconnected.
Improved how NPCs handle being damaged on servers with high latency, reducing desyncs.
Renamed Twin Mask to Twins Mask.
All Work Benches now have the default Work Bench's tooltip.
Added tooltips for usage of healing potions, mana potions, buff potions, and mounts.
Moved the Expert/Master tooltip line of applicable items above prefix effects.
Fixed several issues that could cause updating a Workshop item to publish it as a new entry.
II. Balance
A. Global Mechanics
Now use shared static immunity.
Added Potent Venom, a stronger version of Acid Venom with a short duration.

No longer fires an orb projectile.
Throwing range reduced.

Now swings before it�s thrown.
Thrown hammer size increased significantly, and deals 33% increased damage on first hit.
Now uses local immunity.
Range reduced, still scales with melee speed.
Now reduces its damage by 10% when piercing multiple enemies.

Now applies explosions every 2 hits, dealing 200% damage to a nearby enemy.

Increased damage from 43 to 47.
Increased damage from 39 to 43.
Critical strikes now deal 250% damage instead of 200% damage, and have a visual effect.
Added 20% critical strike chance.
Damage increased from 39 to 40.
No longer sold by Skeleton Merchant.
Is now crafted with Gold/Platinum Bars, Adamantite/Titanium Bars, Souls of Night and Souls of Fright.
Now has a whirlpool surrounding it, increasing its hit detection range significantly.
Splashes 3 waves every fourth hit.
The waves have static immunity.
Increased damage from 95 to 120.
Increased range and speed.
A kraken deployed by the Yoyo Glove moves 25% slower, this gives it more area coverage.
No longer drops in the hardmode dungeon.
Is now dropped from Duke Fishron.
Now inflicts Acid Venom for 2 seconds.
Speed increased from 12 to 16.
Added a visual gradient trail.
Rarity changed from orange to red.
Now applies a crystal explosion every 3 hits, spreading 5 shards.
The hit that causes the explosion deals double damage.
The shards have static immunity, and cannot hit the original enemy.

Now summons the Eye of Cthulhu when the Eye of Cthulhu hits enemies. (Including the Eye of Cthulhu!)

C. Ranged Weapons
Self damage reduced to a flat 60.
Buffed its arrows to split into two bone shards that deal 25% of the arrow's damage.
Damage reduced from 53 to 40.
Is now ranged again!
Now deals 10% increased damage, and has 5% increased critical strike chance, if used while Tipsy.

Damage reduced from 15 to 10.

Now inflicts venom in a splashing cone from its hit point.

D. Magic Weapons
Reworked!
Mana regeneration delay completely removed.
Mana now regenerates even when attacking, at 5% of its normal rate.
Standing still now doubles the full mana regeneration rate, including regeneration from accessories. (roughly 20% better than it was in 1.4.5)
Increased mana regeneration rate when having low mana.
Mana consuming weapons can now be without enough mana, at 40% attack speed. The players squint their eyes when using magic weapons without enough mana.
Mana regeneration rate reduced by 13%

Mana regeneration potion (still) gives maximum mana regeneration rate at all times (As if standing, and as if you had full mana bar), but is now significantly better because it applies while attacking.
Now grants the Mana Surge buff, which increases magic damage by 20%, decaying over 2 seconds, in addition to the mana recovery.
No longer gets pulled by players who are at full mana and not holding magic weapons.

Now crafted using ectoplasm, fallen stars, and greater mana potions.

G. Bosses, Invasions & Events
Shadow Hands damage detection moved to match its hands better.
Fixed cases of Shadow Hands hurting players despite extremely low, unfair visibility.
Everlasting Rainbow can no longer hit players on most faded out sections, reducing the hurting area significantly.
Added warning to several attacks
Phantasmal Eye attack now stops homing after 1.5 seconds, and its explosion radius has been reduced.
Phantasmal Bolt attacks now lock their direction briefly before shooting.
Phantasmal Spheres contact damage is disabled during the first second after they spawn.
Phantasmal Deathray locks its target earlier, allowing for better coordination in multiplayer.
Moon Lord's void highlight now centers on the True Eye of Cthulhu whenever it fires a deathray
Moon Lord & True Eye of Cthulhu no longer deal contact damage.
Deathrays from Moon Lord & True Eye of Cthulhu damage disabled during the first second after they spawn.
True Eyes of Cthulhu maintain better distance from each other and overlap less.
True Eyes of Cthulhu now synchronize their attack patterns with Moon Lord, preventing some impossible-to-dodge situations.
Adjusted Void shader to preserve bright reds and green better, increasing visibility of some of the player's attacks.
Many NPCs will no longer fire at players when off-screen.
Some enemy bullet shots now have a much shorter projectile lifetime.
Santa-NK1's missiles now have a much shorter projectile lifetime.
Man Eater, Angry Trapper, Fungi Bulbs and Clingers no longer pick up money on Expert+ difficulty.
Santa-NK1 shooting range limited to 125 blocks, preventing it from hitting players extremely far away.
Heavily nerfed Nailhead's nail damage, from 120 to 60 in expert mode, and from 270 to 90 in master mode.
Sand Elemental no longer attacks players from significantly far away.
Storm Divers can no longer fly or shoot while confused.
Spiders that can spit webs no longer spit webs while confused.
Snow Balla, Snowman Gangsta, and Evolution Beast no longer fire while confused.
Improved Snow Balla's firing consistency. Yes. Really.
Moss Zombie's spawn chance increased from 1 in 200 to 1 in 30.
Goblin Tinkerer's Self Defense Spiky Balls duration significantly reduced from 60 to 8 seconds.
Storm Lightning no longer harms the Eternia Crystal.
Reduced Meteor Storm's meteor duration to 20 seconds, each.
Added short breaks between Boulder Rain hails.
Explosive Trap damage no longer scales based on difficulty, and now always deals 500 damage.
K. Tools & Utility
Launch, reeling, and swing velocity increased across the board, to catch up to multi-hooks and restore some of its former glory.
